id: \rIf you can't get past me you should give up.
en: \rIf you can't get past me you should give up.
it: \rSe non riesci a superare me, dovresti arrenderti.

id: \rDon't expect an easy victory.
en: \rDon't expect an easy victory.
it: \rNon aspettarti una vittoria facile.

id: \rI haven't seen a challenger in a while.
en: \rI haven't seen a challenger in a while.
it: \rÈ da un po' che non vedo uno sfidante.

id: \rYou may stand a chance. Good luck.
en: \rYou may stand a chance. Good luck.
it: \rForse hai qualche possibilità. Buona fortuna.

id: \rClair: It's rare to see a challenger make it this far.
en: \rClair: It's rare to see a challenger make it this far.
it: \rSandra: È raro vedere uno sfidante arrivare fin qui.

id: \rI don't expect you to win, but let me see if you have what it takes.
en: \rI don't expect you to win, but let me see if you have what it takes.
it: \rNon mi aspetto che tu vinca, ma vediamo se hai la stoffa necessaria.

id: \rClair: It sounded like its coming from the Dragon's Den.
en: \rClair: It sounded like its coming from the Dragon's Den.
it: \rSandra: Sembrava provenire dalla Tana del Drago.

id: \rI need to go investigate. Come along if you want. It's located behind the gym.
en: \rI need to go investigate. Come along if you want. It's located behind the gym.
it: \rDevo andare a indagare. Vieni anche tu, se vuoi. Si trova dietro la Palestra.

id: \rClair: I would like to thank you for all the help you have done.
en: \rClair: I would like to thank you for all the help you have done.
it: \rSandra: Vorrei ringraziarti per tutto l'aiuto che mi hai dato.

id: \rLet's continue our battle, shall we?
en: \rLet's continue our battle, shall we?
it: \rContinuiamo la nostra lotta, che ne dici?

id: \rClair: You've earned the Rising Badge.
en: \rClair: You've earned the Rising Badge.
it: \rSandra: Ti sei guadagnato la Medaglia Levante.

id: \rHere, have this TM too.
en: \rHere, have this TM too.
it: \rEcco, prendi anche questa MT.

id: \rTM02 contains Dragon Claw. A powerful Dragon attack.
en: \rTM02 contains Dragon Claw. A powerful Dragon attack.
it: \rLa MT02 contiene Dragartigli. Un potente attacco di tipo Drago.

id: \rI assume that is your last badge. Good luck in the League.
en: \rI assume that is your last badge. Good luck in the League.
it: \rImmagino che questa sia la tua ultima medaglia. Buona fortuna alla Lega.

id: \bI guess I get to stop you.
en: \bI guess I get to stop you.
it: \bA quanto pare tocca a me fermarti.

id: \bI wish you luck Trainer.
en: \bI wish you luck Trainer.
it: \bTi auguro buona fortuna, Allenatore.

id: \bClair uses Dragon type Pokémon. They are weak against the Dragon, Ice, and Fairy types.
en: \bClair uses Dragon type Pokémon. They are weak against the Dragon, Ice, and Fairy types.
it: \bSandra usa Pokémon di tipo Drago. Sono deboli contro i tipi Drago, Ghiaccio e Folletto.

id: \bThey are strong against Dragon. They are resistant to Electric, Fire, Grass, and Water.
en: \bThey are strong against Dragon. They are resistant to Electric, Fire, Grass, and Water.
it: \bSono forti contro il tipo Drago e resistono ai tipi Elettro, Fuoco, Erba e Acqua.

id: \bI may not have many Dragons, but I will wipe the floor with you.
en: \bI may not have many Dragons, but I will wipe the floor with you.
it: \bForse non avrò molti draghi, ma ti spazzerò via lo stesso.

id: \bI guess having only one isn't the best plan.
en: \bI guess having only one isn't the best plan.
it: \bA quanto pare averne uno solo non è la strategia migliore.

id: \bWelcome to the toughest Gym in Johto.
en: \bWelcome to the toughest Gym in Johto.
it: \bBenvenuto nella Palestra più dura di Johto.

id: \bYou may be one of the few.
en: \bYou may be one of the few.
it: \bForse sei uno dei pochi.
